subject: Azure Partner Center: referral mapping + field on-call coordination
messages:
From: Sarah Lim <sarah.lim@contoso.com>
To: mateo_alvarez <mateo@redwood.com>
Cc: Michael Chen <mchen@contoso.com>
Date: Wed, 01 Dec 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Azure PartnerCenter: initial account list + ask on seller on-call

Hi Mateo,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team liked Redwood's predictable latency profile. We exported our initial marketplace intake and there are ~2.6k accounts flagged for co-sell outreach. I'm attaching a CSV export with the initial account IDs.

Two asks from our side to get the field moving:
- Can we map Contoso account owners (internal MSFT sellers) to Redwood's proposed owner field? A lightweight crosswalk is fine to get started.
- We need a temporary on-call rotation to handle Partner Center referral handoffs for the first 30 days while our seller sync completes. Who at Redwood would be the contact for inbound triage and urgent owner disputes?

Notes: a couple of big accounts are flagged as "shared" (multiple seller owners). We'll need a path for arbitration.

Attachments: contoso_initial_account_list.csv (CSV, 2.6k rows)

Cheers,
Sarah
Partner Programs – Contoso Cloud
From: mateo_alvarez <mateo@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lim <sarah.lim@contoso.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 01 Dec 2027 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Azure PartnerCenter: initial account list + ask on seller on-call

Sarah — thanks for sending this over and for the clear asks. High level reply: we can do a two-track approach (short-term triage/on-call + parallel account crosswalk automation).

Proposed next steps (short):
1) Quick 45m working session to align owners and confirm overlapping/split ownership rules. I can host tomorrow 11:00–11:45 PT or Friday 09:00–09:45 PT.
2) We'll create a simple crosswalk CSV with three fields: contoso_account_id, msft_seller_owner, redwood_owner (owner = email). Vanessa will drive the seller-mapping heuristics.
3) Temporary on-call: Redwood will assign a rotation (1 PME on-call, escalation to Karthik for contested owners). We will publish an escalation email + Slack channel.

I've put a stub doc here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2bContosoOnboarding — will drop the crosswalk template after the session.

Thanks,
Mateo
Head of Partner GTM – Redwood Inference
From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lim <sarah.lim@contoso.com>, mateo_alvarez <mateo@redwood.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 02 Dec 2027 08:28:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Azure PartnerCenter: initial account list + ask on seller on-call

Thanks for the context, Sarah — looping in proposed mapping approach.

Quick notes from seller alignment POV:
- Mapping heuristic: prioritize explicit seller_owner match from Contoso export; fallback to tenant-domain match; final fallback: assign to regional SDR pool for manual claim.
- For shared accounts: add "candidate_owners" column (comma-separated) and mark as "requires-arbitration". Redwood on-call will respond to arbitration requests within 4 business hours.
- Deliverable: contoso_account-crosswalk.csv (attached) — contains sample mappings for 120 accounts to demonstrate rules.

Temporary on-call rotation (proposed):
- Weekdays 8am–6pm PT: PME triage (pmteast@redwood.com) — first touch for PartnerCenter referrals.
- Escalation: karthik_iyer as owner arbitration lead (karthik@redwood.com).
- After-hours: email escalation to partners-oncall@redwood.com (we'll forward to a follow-the-sun rotation).

Attachments: contoso_account-crosswalk.csv

If that looks good we can formalize the rotation and publish the ICS invites.

—Vanessa
Head of Field Programs – Redwood Inference
From: Sarah Lim <sarah.lim@contoso.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, mateo_alvarez <mateo@redwood.com>
Cc: Michael Chen <mchen@contoso.com>
Date: Thu, 02 Dec 2027 10:41:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Azure PartnerCenter: initial account list + ask on seller on-call

Thanks Vanessa — the mapping sample looks sensible. A couple of clarifying items:
- Arbitration SLA: 4 business hours is acceptable for most, but for "strategic" accounts we need 2-hour SLA and direct notification to our Contoso AM. I'll add a tag in the export for strategic=true.
- Visibility: can we get a daily digest of referrals routed and current owner assignments? Automated CSV to our marketplace mailbox would be ideal.

Also looping Michael Chen (Marketplace Ops) — he owns internal buyer/seller pairing at Contoso and will be the primary contact for strategic escalations.

On the on-call rotation: can Redwood provide an ICS invite for the weekly triage slot so our ops team can calendar-block?

Best,
Sarah
From: karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lim <sarah.lim@contoso.com>, vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, mateo_alvarez <mateo@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 05 Dec 2027 16:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Azure PartnerCenter: initial account list + ask on seller on-call

Appreciate the notes, Sarah — short update and plan we executed: 

1) Arbitration SLA: agreed 2 hours for accounts tagged strategic=true in the Contoso export; we've added an "escalation_notify" field that pings the Contoso AM and routes to Karthik if not accepted by owner.
2) Daily digest: automated CSV delivery (07:00 PT) to marketplace@contoso.com — includes referral id, assigned owner, status (accepted/pending/arbitration).
3) ICS invite: attached oncall-rotation.ics — recurring weekly triage slot (Mon–Fri 08:30–09:00 PT) will be sent to Contoso ops mailbox.
4) Next: we'll run an automated sweep to surface overlaps and deliver a reconciliation file next Wednesday.
